<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple product (model product@1): the main picture and up to four thumbnails as a list (named by the
  product), beside the name as the heading, the price, a description and one action. Axes: media (start: the
  pictures before the copy from md up, end: after it, top: above it, wide).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { ProductPhoto } from "./product-simple.types";

export type ProductSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  price: string;
  image?: string;
  imageAlt: string;
  imageSrcset?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionHref?: string;
  photos: ProductPhoto[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  media?: "start" | "end" | "top";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  price,
  image = "",
  imageAlt,
  imageSrcset = "",
  actionLabel = "",
  actionHref = "",
  photos,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "start",
  media = "start",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ProductSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const frame = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "top" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8"
  : "grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-12 md:grid-cols-2"
);
const gallery = computed(() => ((media as string) === "end") ? "" : "order-first");
const ratio = computed(() => ((media as string) === "top") ? "21/9" : "4/3");
const thumbs = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "top" ? "grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-6"
  : "grid-cols-4"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="product-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box :class="frame">
        <Stack gap="6" :align="column">
          <Title :as="level" size="4xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="2xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', cn('text-primary', textAlign))">
            {{ price }}
          </Text>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
          <LinkButton v-if="(actionLabel && actionHref)" variant="default" size="lg" :href="urlOf(actionHref)">
            {{ actionLabel }}
          </LinkButton>
        </Stack>
        <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" :class="gallery">
          <MediaFrame :alt="imageAlt" :src="image" :srcset="imageSrcset" :ratio="ratio" />
          <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', cn('grid gap-4', thumbs))">
            <ListItem v-for="t in photos" :key="t.id" data-slot="thumb">
              <MediaFrame :alt="title" :src="t.image" ratio="1/1" />
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
